title: PEGA Constellation UI Framework Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the next-generation PEGA Constellation UI framework and modern user interface development

questions.question: What is a key architectural component of PEGA Constellation UI?
options: Component Library with reusable UI elements and Design System
questions.explanation: PEGA Constellation UI features a Component Library with reusable UI elements, Design System for consistent visual language, and Theme Engine for customizable styling.

questions.question: Which modern web technologies are used for building custom Constellation components?
questions.explanation: Constellation UI components are built using modern web technologies including React, Web Components, and TypeScript, following a declarative approach with clear separation of concerns.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of design tokens in Constellation UI?
options: Named entities that store visual design attributes in a platform-agnostic way
questions.explanation: Design tokens are named entities that store visual design attributes like colors, typography, and spacing values in a platform-agnostic way, enabling consistent theming and branding.

questions.question: Which CSS techniques does Constellation UI use for responsive design?
options: CSS Grid, Flexbox, and container queries
questions.explanation: Constellation UI implements responsive design using modern CSS techniques including CSS Grid, Flexbox, and container queries, with built-in breakpoints and fluid typography.

questions.question: What accessibility standard should Constellation UI components follow?
questions.explanation: Constellation UI components should follow WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines, using semantic HTML elements, proper ARIA attributes, and inclusive design practices.

questions.question: Which performance optimization technique is used for handling large datasets in Constellation UI?
options: Virtual scrolling to render only visible items
questions.explanation: Virtual scrolling is a key optimization technique that renders only the visible items in large lists, improving performance by reducing DOM nodes and memory usage.

questions.question: How does Constellation UI support different themes and branding?
options: CSS custom properties and design tokens for runtime theme switching
questions.explanation: Constellation UI's theming system uses CSS custom properties and design tokens to enable comprehensive customization, supporting runtime theme switching and multiple brand variations.

questions.question: Which approach ensures component maintainability in Constellation UI?
options: Following consistent design patterns and using reusable component libraries
Building components for single use cases only
questions.explanation: Maintainable components require consistent design patterns, reusable component libraries, proper documentation, and following separation of concerns between presentation, logic, and data.
